name: quinbook-mcp
description: Talk to your quinbook ticketing system in plain language — bookings, slots, calendar, contacts, coupons and cart/order operations as tools for Claude.
long_description: MCP server exposing the quinbook public API. Read tools for slots, orders, coupons and contacts; write tools for cart, order lifecycle and contacts that execute immediately (the bundled skills require confirming with the user first). OAuth login with your own quinbook credentials; multi-tenant via me_switch_company.

api_base_url.title: API server
api_base_url.description: quinbook API base URL. Leave at the default unless quinbook support told you otherwise. Note: every server talks to live production data — there is no sandbox.
